source.purpose: Retry GE fields that failed in the full probe with values and preconditions inferred from the NeoX user guide.
notes: Cases may include multiple fields when the user guide indicates a feature needs an enable flag plus mode/value fields.
Some VLAN TLS/trunk/translation features are documented as unsupported on NXC/NXP; expected failures are still recorded for negative-case evidence.
QoS profile-name cases require profiles to exist before assigning them to the GE port.

candidates.name: oui_filter_colon_format
candidates.pdf_basis: OUI Filter requires the first three octets in xx:xx:xx format.

candidates.name: packet_filter_pppoe_only
candidates.pdf_basis: Packet-Filter Type supports Accept All, PPPoE Only, and Custom Reject.

candidates.name: packet_filter_custom_reject_ip
candidates.pdf_basis: Custom Reject must be paired with at least one reject type.

candidates.name: packet_filter_custom_reject_arp
candidates.pdf_basis: Custom Reject options include protocol packet types such as IP and ARP.

candidates.name: lldp_admin_txrx
candidates.pdf_basis: LLDP Admin Status has Disable, Tx-only, Rx-only, and Tx-Rx.

candidates.name: lldp_basic_tlv_with_txrx
candidates.pdf_basis: LLDP Basic TLV options include Management Address, System Description, and System Name.

candidates.name: lldp_org_tlv_with_txrx
candidates.pdf_basis: LLDP Org-specific TLV options include IEEE 802.1 Port VLAN ID and IEEE 802.3 Link Aggregation.

candidates.name: dhcp_policy_pdf_values
candidates.pdf_basis: DHCP option handling supports Drop/Replace/Keep; LinkLocal option includes Skip-src.

candidates.name: dhcp_snooping_untrust
candidates.pdf_basis: Port DHCP screen uses Trust/Untrust for DHCP and DHCPv6.

candidates.name: vlan_pvid_with_vlan_precreated
candidates.pdf_basis: PVID valid range is 1 to 4094; pbit valid range is 0 to 7.

candidates.name: vlan_list_fixed_with_vlan_precreated
candidates.pdf_basis: VLAN membership requires a valid VLAN ID and mode.

candidates.name: vlan_translation_with_vlan_precreated
candidates.pdf_basis: VLAN translation uses VLAN IDs 1 to 4094 and spbit 0 to 7.

candidates.name: qos_profile_names_precreated
candidates.pdf_basis: Port QoS selects existing Rate-Limit, Shaping, and Weight profiles.

candidates.name: ge_advanced_mtu_tel
candidates.pdf_basis: GE advanced screen exposes MTU and TEL-NO.

candidates.name: ddmi_threshold_pdf_ranges
candidates.pdf_basis: DDMI/threshold ranges are taken from documented alarm-profile ranges and GE DDMI descriptions.
